def nm(X):
    c,_,_,_=np.linalg.lstsq(X,dA_dt,rcond=None)
    return np.mean((X@c-dA_dt)**2)/np.var(dA_dt)

import numpy as np
def equation(t, A, params):
    return (params[0]*np.exp(-params[1]*A**2)
            + params[2]*np.log(A)*np.exp(-params[3]*t)
            + params[4]/(1+params[5]*t)
            + params[6]*np.sin(params[7]*np.sqrt(A))*np.exp(-params[8]*t**2)
            + params[9])
